q.q: Which Three Village hamlet was settled in 1655, the first settlement in what became the Town of Brookhaven?
q.f: Settlers from New England bought the land from the Setalcott people in 1655. Setauket takes its name from them.

q.q: In local tradition, what did Anna Strong hang on her clothesline to signal the Culper spies?
q.f: Setauket legend says a black petticoat meant the courier had arrived, and handkerchiefs showed which cove he was hiding in.

q.q: Setauket farmer Abraham Woodhull spied for George Washington under what code name?
q.f: Woodhull was "Samuel Culper Sr." The ring's spymaster, Setauket-born Benjamin Tallmadge, went by "John Bolton."

q.q: The Stony Brook Post Office eagle flaps its wings how often?
q.f: The mechanical eagle has flapped its wings every hour on the hour, from 8 AM to 8 PM, since 1941.

q.q: In what year did Ward Melville open the Stony Brook Village Center?
q.f: The Village Center opened in July 1941 and was built around a village green as part of Ward and Dorothy Melville's vision for Stony Brook.

q.q: Ward Melville's family company ran which famous chain of shoe stores?
q.f: The Melville Shoe Corporation opened its first Thom McAn store in New York City in 1922.

q.q: The Hercules figurehead in Stony Brook once sat on the bow of which ship?
q.f: The USS Ohio was the first ship launched from the Brooklyn Navy Yard, in 1820. Hercules has watched over Stony Brook Harbor since the 1950s.

q.q: About how old is the Stony Brook Grist Mill?
q.f: The mill dates to about 1751 and is described as Long Island's most completely equipped working grist mill.

q.q: Setauket's Caroline Church was renamed to honor whom?
o: The wife of the first minister
q.f: It began as Christ Church and was renamed for Queen Caroline. The building on the Setauket green was consecrated in 1729.

q.q: During the 1777 Battle of Setauket, Loyalist troops fortified which building?
q.f: On August 22, 1777, Connecticut troops attacked the fortified Presbyterian meeting house but could not take it. Today's church dates to 1812.

q.q: When George Washington toured Long Island in April 1790, he spent a night at whose house in Setauket?
q.f: Washington stayed at Austin Roe's on April 22, 1790. Roe had carried messages for the Culper spy ring during the war.

q.q: What does the Old Field Point Lighthouse serve as today?
o: The Village of Old Field's village hall
q.f: The current lighthouse was built in 1868. The village uses it for its village hall, and a modern beacon still guides boats.

q.q: Thomas Hodgkins built the Emma S. Clark Memorial Library in memory of his...
q.f: The library opened on October 3, 1892, on what would have been Emma Clark's birthday.

q.q: Before moving to Stony Brook, where did Stony Brook University hold its first classes in 1957?
q.f: Classes began at the Planting Fields estate in Oyster Bay. The Stony Brook campus opened in 1962.

q.q: What is the name of Stony Brook University's mascot?
q.f: Wolfie cheers on the Stony Brook Seawolves at home games all year.

q.q: Which painter famous for scenes of everyday Long Island life was born in Setauket in 1807?
q.f: William Sidney Mount painted farmers, musicians and village life around Stony Brook and Setauket.

q.q: The Long Island Museum in Stony Brook is known for its collection of...
q.f: The museum's Carriage Museum shows off horse-drawn carriages and sleighs from Long Island's past.

q.q: Which AMC drama told the story of Setauket's Revolutionary War spy ring?
q.f: TURN: Washington's Spies ran from 2014 to 2017 and followed Abraham Woodhull and the Culper Ring.

q.q: Culper Ring spymaster Benjamin Tallmadge grew up in Setauket. What was his father's job?
o: Minister of the Setauket Presbyterian Church
q.f: His father was the minister of the Presbyterian church on the Setauket village green.

q.q: What are the sports teams at Ward Melville High School called?
q.f: A fitting name for a school in the heart of Culper spy country.

q.q: Stony Brook Harbor opens onto which body of water?
q.f: Stony Brook Harbor, West Meadow and Port Jefferson Harbor all open onto Long Island Sound.
